STAGE: design-check for ideation_3 round 2 (single new idea, distinct from my previous submission and from CURVCTRL-SID / cocond-markov-poincare-ot / poincare-frechet-successor-codebook / BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS / MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ / SUCC-GEO-CBTAB / LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ / behcone-prefix-rq / succboost-geoshift).
GOAL: pick a coupling position that the earlier rounds did not occupy and that cannot suffer the CURVCTRL-SID saturation defect.
READ: the round brief plus the defect note on CURVCTRL-SID (per-level hard prefix hit rate -> c_l = (1/Q_l - 1)/(rho_l^2+eps), cap 0.99/max|z|^2 binds for all Q_l < ~0.95, so curvature became constant).
OBSERVED (reasoning): the saturated families are (a) curvature/weight/temperature derived from a behaviour statistic, (b) behaviour mass injected into the assignment (Sinkhorn/OT), (c) successor-weighted codebook barycentre updates, (d) behaviour cones, (e) inference-time beam rerankers. Unoccupied: the residual CHAIN itself, i.e. the transport that carries the level-l residual from the chosen centroid to the next level's domain. In a curved space parallel transport is path dependent (holonomy), and the path can be chosen by training-only behaviour. Removing curvature makes transport path independent, so behaviour becomes inert: the two factors are forced to be load bearing in one expression with no protective bound anywhere.
DECISION: submit HOLOSUCC-RQ. Curvature fixed at c=1 (canonical curvature normalisation of the hyperboloid, no tuning, no cap needed because the encoder output is normalised by the measured per-epoch max|z| before exp_0^c, per the amended rule z_hat = z/max|z|). Behaviour enters as a waypoint w_{i,l} = exp_0^c(sum_j pi_ij log_0^c q_{l,k_l(j)}) in the transport path q -> w -> 0. Effect size is the holonomy rotation theta = c * Area(triangle), continuous in w, no saturation.
OPEN: numerical stability of exp/log/PT near the ball boundary; staleness of the per-epoch waypoint table; whether code churn at levels 2..L translates into Stage3 recall.

const ans = `IDEA: HOLOSUCC-RQ
TITLE: Successor-chosen hyperbolic transport paths make the RQ residual chain pick up curvature-dependent holonomy, re-routing Semantic-ID codes without inflating the residual.
MOTIVATION: RQ-VAE semantic IDs are assigned by a Euclidean residual chain: the centroid at level l is subtracted, and the leftover vector is quantized at level l+1. Nothing in that leftover knows which items actually follow item i in training sessions, so two items that are genuine successors can drift into unrelated level-2/3 prefixes and the autoregressive prior has nothing stable to latch onto. An item whose successors all live in one region of code space should carry its lower-order codes in a frame oriented toward that region.
NOVELTY: Earlier mechanisms put behaviour into the curvature value (CURVCTRL-SID), into the assignment mass (cocond-markov-poincare-ot), into codebook barycentres (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook), into cones (behcone-prefix-rq) or into inference-time reranking (succboost-geoshift). This one never touches the codebook, never reweights the assignment, and never reranks. It changes only the TRANSPORT PATH along which the level-l residual is carried to the origin of the next level. In a curved space the transport along q -> w -> 0 differs from the transport along the direct geodesic q -> 0 by a rotation whose angle is the holonomy c * Area(triangle). Behaviour picks the waypoint w; curvature turns that waypoint into a rotation of the residual; the rotation changes which code level l+1 selects and therefore the SID. With c = 0 the difference is identically zero, so the behaviour signal is inert unless the curvature is present: the coupling is not a product of two additive terms but a geometric obstruction.
CHANGE: Replace the Euclidean residual update u_{l+1} = u_l - e_l by a parallel transport of the logarithmic residual at the chosen centroid, routed through a per-item successor waypoint: u_{l+1} = PT^c_{w -> 0}( PT^c_{q -> w}( log^c_q(P_{l-1}) ) ). Reconstruction inverts the same path, so the network still reconstructs the item and only the orientation of the deeper residuals changes.
SPECIFICATION: Work on the hyperboloid H^n_c = { X in R^{n+1} : <X,X>_L = -1/c, X_0 > 0 } with <X,Y>_L = -X_0 Y_0 + sum_i X_i Y_i and FIXED c = 1 (canonical curvature normalisation; no tuning, no cap). Ball coordinates are used only to normalise the encoder output. Let E = Enc(x) in R^n, s = measured max_E |E| over the catalogue refreshed once per epoch (stop-grad), z = E/s so |z| <= 1, and P_0 = to_H( exp^c_0(z) ) with exp^c_0(z) = tanh(sqrt(c)|z|) z / (sqrt(c)|z|). Level codebooks live as points q_{l,k} = to_H( exp^c_0( e_{l,k}/s_l ) ) with s_l = max_k |e_{l,k}| measured per epoch. Forward for l = 1..L: k_l = argmin_k d^c_H(P_{l-1}, q_{l,k}); v_l = Log^c_{q_{l,k_l}}(P_{l-1}); u_l = PT^c_{w_{i,l} -> 0}( PT^c_{q_{l,k_l} -> w_{i,l}}( v_l ) ); P_l = Exp^c_0(u_l). Reconstruction walks the same path backwards from P_L down to P_0 and the loss is d^c_H(P_0, P_hat_0)^2 plus the baseline commitment term. Waypoints are rebuilt once per epoch from a stop-grad assignment table: w_{i,l} = Exp^c_0( sum_j pi_ij Log^c_0( q_{l, K[l][j]} ) ) with pi_ij = n_ij / sum_j' n_ij' over ALL training successors (no top-m truncation) and w_{i,l} := q_{l,K[l][i]} when item i has no training successors. Because every point entering exp^c_0 has norm <= 1, the ball constraint c|p|^2 < 1 holds for any c with margin (radius <= tanh(1) = 0.7616), so no protective clip on curvature is needed anywhere.
COST: At the frozen scale the batch is 24556/24 = 1023 items and L = 4, so a step performs 1023 * 4 = 4092 transport chains, each about six Exp/Log/PT evaluations of dimension 64, roughly 5e6 extra flops per step, i.e. well under 1 ms on one card and negligible against the encoder. The only material cost is the once-per-epoch catalogue pass used to refresh the assignment table and waypoints: 24556 encoder forwards, which is 1/24 of an epoch's encoder work (about 4 percent of an epoch, amortised to roughly one extra batch forward per 24 steps), plus a sparse matmul over the training transition nonzeros of size nnz(T_train) * L * d (about 1.3e8 flops per epoch at 20 successors per item). Memory grows by one float table of shape 24556 * 4 * 64 = 25 MB. Total wall clock at 3000 epochs and 72000 steps: about +3 to +6 percent over baseline.
HYPOTHESIS: It is worth keeping if the residual component lying in the plane spanned by the chosen centroid and the successor waypoint carries information about what comes next, so that rotating it consistently per item makes the level-2+ codes of an item and its high-probability successors more aligned and the autoregressive prior predicts the level-2+ tokens more often. Observation: the per-level holonomy angle histogram should be broad and centred well away from zero (order 0.05 to 1.5 rad, not piled at 0 and not piled at pi); at least about 5 percent of items should change at least one code at level >= 2 relative to the geometry-off path; the conditional level-2 prefix hit rate given the true level-1 should rise; and Stage3 test_recall@10 should exceed 0.065.
RISKS: For many items the successor waypoint may lie almost on the direct geodesic, making the holonomy tiny and the mechanism inert; conversely a large rotation can churn the deeper codes faster than the codebook adapts and destabilise training. The per-epoch waypoint table is stale by up to one epoch, which adds noise exactly where the rotation is sharpest. The autoregressive prior may simply re-fit whatever codes it is given, in which case the change shows up in the code statistics but not in recall. Fixed c = 1 may not match the intrinsic scale of the learned latent, although the max|z| normalisation is designed to remove that dependence.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transitions extracted from the training split, aggregated into a row-normalised successor distribution pi_i over the training catalogue; used as the weights that define the hyperbolic waypoint of item i at each RQ level.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: One pass over the training interaction sequences ordered by timestamp; every consecutive pair (a, b) inside a user's training history, and every (a, b) with b occurring after a within the training window, increments n_ab; pi_ij = n_ij / sum_j' n_ij'. Items with zero out-degree get the degenerate waypoint w_{i,l} = q_{l,K[l][i]}. The vector W[i,l] is rebuilt once per epoch as a sparse-matrix product of pi with the current level-l code point table. Only the training split is read.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: pi is built exclusively from training-split sequences; validation and test interactions are never read while constructing pi, the waypoint table, the assignment table or the codebooks. SIDs are materialised from the trained encoder plus the training-derived waypoints and are then frozen; Stage 3 consumes them as fixed integer token tuples, and no validation or test co-occurrence, popularity or prefix statistic can enter the code assignment.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Fixed negative curvature c = 1 hyperboloid (equivalently the Poincare ball with curvature -1). Operations used: exponential map Exp^c_x, logarithmic map Log^c_x, and parallel transport PT^c_{x -> y}(v) = v + c <y,v>_L / (1 - c <x,y>_L) * (x + y), which is an isometry T_x -> T_y. The composite PT^c_{w -> 0} o PT^c_{q -> w} differs from PT^c_{q -> 0} by the holonomy of the geodesic triangle (0, q, w), a rotation in the plane of that triangle by exactly theta = c * Area(triangle).
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: Inside the quantizer, between consecutive RQ levels: the transport that carries the level-l residual from the chosen centroid into the tangent space at the origin where level l+1 quantizes. It also appears in the inverse transport used by the reconstruction path, so both the assignment and the training gradient see it.
COUPLING PATH: Behaviour defines the intermediate point w_{i,l} of the transport path; curvature makes transport path dependent, so the path through w rotates the residual by the enclosed hyperbolic area; that rotated residual is the input to the level-(l+1) assignment, hence the code k_{l+1} and the whole SID. Removal of behaviour collapses the path to the direct geodesic and the rotation is the identity. Removal of curvature makes transport path independent and the rotation is the identity for every path. Either switch alone makes the other operand produce no observable change, so the core computation is genuinely joint.
COUPLING EQUATION: u_{l+1} = PT^c_{w_{i,l} -> 0} ( PT^c_{q_{l,k_l} -> w_{i,l}} ( Log^c_{q_{l,k_l}}(P_{l-1}) ) ), with the curved term q_{l,k_l} = Exp^c_0( e_{l,k_l} / max_k |e_{l,k}| ) and the behaviour term w_{i,l} = Exp^c_0( sum_j pi_ij Log^c_0( q_{l, K[l][j]} ) ), whose difference from the direct transport is the rotation by theta_{i,l} = c * Area(Delta(0, q_{l,k_l}, w_{i,l})); theta is continuous in w and in c, with theta -> 0 exactly when w -> q or c -> 0.
OBSERVABLES: Distribution of theta_{i,l} per level (mean, median, 5th and 95th percentile) — must be broad and away from zero, which is the direct check that the earlier saturation defect is absent; fraction of items whose code at level >= 2 changes relative to the geometry-off path; per-level code usage entropy; conditional prefix hit rate P(level-2 token correct | true level-1 token correct) and the same for level 3; reconstruction d^c_H(P_0, P_hat_0) per level (should stay close to the geometry-off value because transport preserves the residual magnitude); and Stage3 test_recall@10 against the 0.065 target.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: Set w_{i,l} := q_{l,k_l} for every item, so the path is q -> q -> 0, the composite transport equals PT^c_{q -> 0}, the holonomy is identically zero, and the model is a plain hyperbolic RQ-VAE with the same fixed c = 1 and the same reconstruction. Selected by the config switch use_successor_waypoint = False. Code path exists and is unit-tested against the direct transport; it is NOT trained this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: Set c -> 0, which sends Exp/Log to identity and PT to the identity identification of tangent spaces, and replaces d^c_H by Euclidean distance, so the path through w has no effect at all and the mechanism reduces to standard Euclidean RQ-VAE. Selected by use_curvature = False. Code path exists; NOT trained this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: The full run: c = 1, waypoint w_{i,l} from training-split transitions, transport q -> w -> 0 at every level, reconstruction by inverse path, standard commitment loss. This is the single trained candidate of the round.
SPEC EQUATIONS: to_H(p) = ( (1 + c|p|^2)/(1 - c|p|^2) / sqrt(c), 2p/(1 - c|p|^2) ); Exp^c_x(v) = cosh(sqrt(c)|v|) x + sinh(sqrt(c)|v|)/(sqrt(c)|v|) * v with |v| = sqrt(<v,v>_L); Log^c_x(y) = d * (y + c<x,y>_L x) / |y + c<x,y>_L x|_L with d = d^c_H(x,y); d^c_H(x,y) = (1/sqrt(c)) arccosh( clamp(-c<x,y>_L, 1+1e-8, inf) ); PT^c_{x->y}(v) = v + c<y,v>_L/(1 - c<x,y>_L) * (x + y). Pseudocode per epoch: (1) no-grad catalogue pass -> E_i, z_i = E_i / max|E|, P_0^i, assignments K[l][i]; (2) W[i,l] = Exp^c_0( sum_j pi_ij Log^c_0( Q[l][K[l][j]] ) ), with W[i,l] = Q[l][K[l][i]] if out-degree(i) = 0; (3) for each training step, for each item in the batch: P = P_0; for l in 1..L: k_l = argmin_k d^c_H(P, Q[l][k]); v = Log^c_{Q[l][k_l]}(P); u = PT^c_{W[i,l] -> 0}( PT^c_{Q[l][k_l] -> W[i,l]}( v ) ); P = Exp^c_0(u); store (l, k_l, v, u); then R = P; for l = L..1: t = PT^c_{0 -> W[i,l]}( PT^c_{W[i,l] -> Q[l][k_l]}( Log^c_0(R) ) ); R = Exp^c_{Q[l][k_l]}(t); loss = d^c_H(P_0, R)^2 + beta * || stopgrad(Enc(x)) - sg ||^2 (baseline commitment, unchanged); (4) backward through the Exp/Log/PT chain and the codebooks.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs are the encoder latent E in R^n, the per-level codebooks e_{l,k} in R^n (L = 4, d = 64 in the frozen protocol), the row-normalised training successor matrix pi (sparse, nnz = number of distinct training transitions), the measured scales s = max|E| and s_l = max_k |e_{l,k}|, and the fixed curvature c = 1. Outputs are the integer code tuple (k_1, ..., k_L) used as the semantic ID, the reconstruction point R in H^n_c, the scalar loss, and the recorded diagnostics theta_{i,l} and the transported tangents u_l.
SAFEGUARDS: Clamp the arccosh argument to at least 1 + 1e-8; clamp sqrt(c)|v| to at least 1e-8 before dividing in Exp/Log; because every point fed to exp^c_0 has norm <= 1, the ball radius never exceeds tanh(1) = 0.7616 and the Lorentz denominator 1 - c<x,y>_L is bounded below by 1; the PT formula preserves <v,v>_L exactly, so residual magnitude cannot blow up and is asserted in a unit test; the reconstruction uses the exact inverse transports, so the same bounds apply in the backward walk; the waypoint table is stop-gradient and rebuilt once per epoch so no second-order term crosses it; theta is logged, never clipped and never used as a gate; no curvature cap, no clip on the coupling, no temperature, no sweep, single seed, single training run on the frozen 3000-epoch Stage 2 budget and the frozen Stage 3 protocol.
END IDEA`;
const r2 = await tools.progress.append_progress({content: ans});
return r2;
